signing.key_rotation: new signing keys must be published in JWKS before tokens using them are issued

lifetime.refresh_model: issue a new short-lived service credential; do not extend an existing token

security_requirements: private signing keys never leave GoreeCloud Identity
producer systems must not self-sign, mint, or substitute GoreeCloud Mesh service credentials
tokens must not contain user content, secrets, backup payloads, prompts, or private application data
service_id must match the authenticated workload identity represented by sub
consumers must validate signature, issuer, audience, expiry, not-before, service identity, and required scope
unknown kid, unsupported algorithm, missing required claim, malformed scope, or invalid temporal claim must fail closed
deployment_boundary: Runtime token issuance and JWKS generation are implemented. Production acceptance requires durable Identity-managed signing-key storage, a deployed JWKS endpoint, live service-token issuance, rotation evidence, and successful end-to-end Mesh verification.
